purpose: Teach: カルシウム/材質/耕作/司教/旧約/起立/見識/人身

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者のカルシウム値を医療チームで日々管理します
lines.en: Ren, we monitor our patients' calcium levels as a team every day.
lines.style: Steady, clear delivery. Even pacing. No inflection on the clinical details — matter-of-fact competence. Warm but professional distance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、手術器具の材質を医療チームで再点検します
lines.en: Yes, we do a full materials recheck on all surgical instruments as a team.
lines.style: Measured affirmation. Slight pause before the commitment. Crisp on 'recheck' — precision matters here. Calm certainty.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、農作業従事者の耕作中怪我を医療チームで扱います
lines.en: Ren, we handle injuries to farm workers during fieldwork as a team in our practice.
lines.style: Same calm register as before. Direct eye contact level. No condescension — treating his question as seriously as the case itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 司教様の終末期医療を、貴院、担当されますね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital takes on the bishop's end-of-life care, sensei?
lines.style: Respectful, thoughtful. Careful with the formality — not stiff, just genuinely deferential. A genuine question underneath the courtesy.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の希望に旧約聖書朗読を医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Yes, we make sure to respond as a team to his request to hear Old Testament passages read aloud.
lines.style: Gentle but factual. Slight warmth on the accommodation — this matters to the patient. Steady delivery, no hurry.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の起立性低血圧を医療チームで日常的に診ます
lines.en: Yes, we monitor orthostatic hypotension in our patients as part of routine daily care.
lines.style: Clear, practical. Competent rhythm. The fatigue lives in her shoulders, not in the crisp delivery of clinical fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療者の見識を、貴院、研鑽されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does invest in developing your medical team's expertise, sensei.
lines.style: Observation phrased as respect. Genuine, not flattery. Slight pause before 'expertise' — noticing something real about the place.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、人身事故被害者の救命を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we take responsibility for saving the lives of traffic accident victims as a team.
lines.style: Firm with conviction. Weight on 'responsibility' — this is non-negotiable. Close, intimate delivery despite the formal context. Tired but unwavering.
